preconditions.description: The input N must be a positive integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(binary) == N for binary in stdout)
postconditions.description: All output binary strings must have a length equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(binary.count('1') >= binary.count('0') for binary in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output binary string must have more 1's than 0's for any prefix of the string.
The output binary strings must be in decreasing lexicographical order.
